R29-SLICE-BRANCH.statement: physical endpoint Q-image avoids all seven F7 branch lines
R29-SLICE-BRANCH.attack_consequence: physical endpoint lies in unramified F7 locus

R29-SLICE-S3FIX.statement: Q-liftable coordinate-permutation S3 stabilizer is trivial on physical endpoint Q-points
dependencies: 2 is not a square in Q
a projective Q-fixed 3-cycle has scalar lambda in Q with lambda^3=1, hence lambda=1
R29-SLICE-S3FIX.attack_consequence: no physical endpoint Q-point lies on a nontrivial Q-liftable S3 fixed locus

R29-SLICE-LD6.statement: all degree<=6 integral curve carriers are classified and no positive nondegenerate physical family occurs

R29-COV-CLOSED-SLICES.statement: the finite union of currently certified closed slice families/classes is a proper geometric subset of the irreducible endpoint surface
dependencies: each listed closed family/class is positive codimension

R29-COV-K3-PUSH.statement: every physical endpoint Q-point pushes to the smooth locus of each Q-defined coordinate-sign normal quotient and hence to a Q-point on its minimal K3 resolution
dependencies: physical endpoint avoids coordinate-sign fixed loci
physical endpoint avoids F7 ramification arrangement
minimal resolution is an isomorphism over the normal quotient smooth locus
